entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Kestrel WebTransport completes a client unidirectional stream's reader at FIN, before the app reads buffered data #70386
  • Kestrel WebTransport rejects RFC 9297 clients: H3_DATAGRAM uses draft codepoint 0xffd277 instead of 0x33 #70384
  • [API Proposal]: AuthenticationProperties.RotateSessionKey, to rotate the cookie session identifier on sign-in #70373
  • [Blazor] Transparent service invocation across Interactive Server and WebAssembly render modes #70372

Closed

  • BlazorWebTemplate_ConditionalPasskeyRegistration reads response body after navigation #69494

PullRequests

Created

  • Cleanup unused parameter from /PasskeyRequestOptions #70387
    area-commandlinetools
  • Prevent Blazor WebAssembly loading progress from decreasing or reaching 100% early #70385
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • [blazor] Use runtime dotnet.d.ts declaration in VMR builds #70383
    area-infrastructure
  • [blazor] Synchronize navigation lock test with browser prompt updates #70382
    area-blazor
  • OutputCaching: Avoid caching exceptions when request is canceled #70381
    area-middleware
  • [test-quarantine] Unquarantine VirtualizationTest.ScrollToItem_AfterEndJump_LandsAtTarget #70380
    test-failure
  • [test-quarantine] Unquarantine RedirectionTest.RedirectEnhancedNonBlazorGetToInternal #70379
    test-failure
  • [test-quarantine] Unquarantine VirtualizeTest.ScrollToIndexAsync_CancellationCancelsProviderRequest #70378
    test-failure

    test-failure, re-quarantine
  • [test-quarantine] Re-quarantine VirtualizationTest.QuickGrid_AnchorMode_NearTop_AppendKeepsViewportStable #70376
    test-failure, re-quarantine
  • [test-quarantine] Re-quarantine ServerEventTest.EventDuringBatchRendering_CanTriggerDOMEvents #70375
    test-failure, re-quarantine

Merged

  • Avoid parsing Content-Type and allocating Items in HasFormContentType #70163
    area-networking
  • Avoid enumerator allocations when evaluating authorization handlers #70147
    area-auth
  • Revert "[blazor] Extract current dotnet.d.ts from runtime pack for re… #70374
    area-infrastructure, area-blazor
  • Avoid per-line MemoryStream in BufferedReadStream.ReadLine #70156
    area-networking
  • Use span-based data protection in SecureDataFormat #70228
    area-auth
  • [release/11.0] [Blazor] Fix Endpoints linker substitution assembly name #70247
    Servicing-approved, area-blazor
  • Fix quarantine eligibility blind spots #70371
  • Capture passkey upgrade HTML before automatic navigation #70362
    area-commandlinetools
  • [test-quarantine] Re-quarantine ServerRoutingTest.NavigationLock_CanBlockExternalNavigation #70369

Updated

    area-networking
  • Make Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebView trim/NativeAOT compatible #69950
    area-infrastructure, area-blazor, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • Allow rotating the cookie session key on sign-in #70105
    area-auth, community-contribution
  • Reduce per-call overhead in UserValidator #70224
    area-identity
  • Allow draft PRs to defer originating and API proposal issues #70313

    area-auth, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
